correctness.rationale: Illumination of the translated disk is reduced exactly to strict containment in the lattice triangle. Assuming maximal center-to-vertex radius at most sqrt(5), strict inradius greater than one and triangle isoperimetry force area above 3 sqrt(3); lattice half-integrality and the circumdisk area bound leave only areas 11/2 and 6. The complete sum-of-two-squares/Heron enumeration then forces a side of length at least four, contradicting the strict side-line distance. The explicit family proves sharpness and nonattainment. The checker replays the only finite enumeration.
